revised_claim_text: [ASSUMED-N]: Enterprise TMS year-1 professional services for SAP TM or Oracle OTM implementations are commonly cited in the range of $800K–$6M, with SAP TM consulting fees often cited at $800K–$1.5M for mid-market rollouts and significantly higher for global enterprise deployments — however, no primary analyst-firm (Gartner, Forrester, Nucleus, ARC) or Tier-1 SI public disclosure was found to validate the upper end of this range. Evidence is limited to a practitioner consultant blog (noeldcosta.com), a competitor vendor blog (locus.sh), and a software review site (selecthub.com). To validate: request Gartner Critical Capabilities for TMS (paywalled), Nucleus Research TMS deployment cost notes, or ARC's TMS SI market study.
notes: Budget exhausted (8 WebSearch, 6 WebFetch attempts). The $2M–$6M enterprise year-1 professional services figure is plausible for large-scale, global SAP TM or Oracle OTM rollouts based on industry context (a $1M engagement for a mid-market, single-region implementation was found), but no primary analyst source with methodology-backed cost bands was surfaced in public domain. The Gartner MQ and Nucleus TMS reports do not include implementation cost benchmarks in their public-facing material. UpperEdge has no public SAP TM cost content. No Tier-1 SI (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, Capgemini) has publicly disclosed TMS deal values. The claim should be marked ASSUMED-N and flagged for primary-source validation.
